findings.title: Missing parameter in call to extend_due_date
findings.body: The new `extend_due_date` function requires a `days` parameter, but the caller in `renewals.py` line 15 passes none, so the call will raise `TypeError`. Add the `days` argument to the call.

summary.problem: The change to `extend_due_date` breaks the existing caller in `renewals.py` by removing the default extension period.
summary.done_well: The function’s signature and implementation now accept a configurable extension period.
